title: Capacity Safeguard & Autoscale Experimentation Sprint — Q3 Roadmap
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Summary: Develop a reproducible quarterly roadmap and playbook for testing autoscale strategies and capacity safeguards for Dedicated pools. Focus on controlled experiments that balance latency SLOs, unit cost, and pool resilience. This ticket coordinates PM-level planning, success metrics, hypotheses to validate, and cross-functional alignment for Q3.

Objectives: 
- Ship an experimentation plan for three autoscale strategies (predictive prewarm, demand hedging via warm reservoirs, and latency-first fastpath) with clear signals and rollback controls.
- Produce a Capacity Safeguard playbook that operators can run during surge events (steps, thresholds, and automated fallbacks).
- Validate economic impact (expected token cost delta) and user-facing latency tradeoffs on at least two representative workloads (chat agent and high-throughput embeddings).

Success metrics: 
- Two experiments run to completion with statistically significant results (p < 0.05) on latency and cost.
- No customer-facing SLO breaches during experiment windows; internal canary to 5% of traffic.
- Playbook documented and tested with on-call runbook drill; TTR to baseline < 6 hours for common failure modes.

Deliverables: 
- Experiment matrix (hypotheses, metrics, instrumentation)
- Playbook (confluence page + runbook)
- Dashboard tiles showing experiment signals and cost delta per pool
- Postmortem-style report with recommendation and rollout plan

Stakeholders: 
- PM lead: Priya Nair (assignee)
- Eng leads: Sofia Martinez (Serving Runtime), Arjun Desai (Infra Autoscale)
- Research: Samir Khan (evals & metrics)
- Design: Ellen Wu (console flows + operator UX)
- SRE/Oncall: Maya Grant

Artifacts/links: 
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DED/pages/Capacity+Safeguard+Q3
- PRD draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example/Capacity-Safeguard-PRD
- Runtime experiment infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123
- Console dashboard (workshop): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/capacity-safeguard-q3

Notes on scope & constraints: 
- We will only run experiments on Dedicated pools with isolated test customers and canary routing to 5% of production traffic. Private deployments are out of scope for this quarter but will be captured in follow-ups.
- Cost modeling will use the Optimize toolkit + billing sandbox; engineering estimates required for GPU startup/teardown costs.
- Any experiment that risks multi-customer impact requires formal approval from CRO and SRE leads.
